name: Linear Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: On September 21st, the Linear stable coin $LUSD appears to be under an exploit attack. While the team investigates, do not buy LUSD, do not trade $LUSD. Liquidations are paused and users accounts are not at risk.
